steps.text: 04:22 P.M. \ Clear
Rhodes Island Landship, Compartment 5, Training Grounds

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hoo! Hah!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Cleave! Thrust! Swing!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Phew... Haah...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: That... concludes... *Pant* *pant*... today's training.

options: Know your limits. You're pushing yourself too hard.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: No, phew.... Don't worry! I'm a-okay, Doctor.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I know myself. And I'm well within my limits here.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann and Liskarm helped me work out a training schedule, so you don't have to worry!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh? What's the matter, Doctor? Why do you look so worried?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Really, I'm fine! It's hard, but I can handle it!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Phew... *pant*... thanks.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Haah.... Okay, I'm good. But this drink, ugh, it really tastes terrible.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Dobermann made it very clear I'm supposed to drink this after exercise, and so has Franka, but it really tastes awful!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: The operators training here always work so hard. I have to go all out. I can't hold anyone back.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, by the way, Doctor, I'm going on a mission with the other Blacksteel girls in a couple of days and won't be training here for a while. So thanks so much for everything you've done for me here!

options: You look like you have something to say.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hah, perceptive as always, Doctor... Am I so easy to read?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Well, I'm really glad to go on a Blacksteel mission. It's just...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I, uh, I have a few pets, and, uh, I usually take care of them. But when I'm on a mission, I have to ask other people to do it.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I usually ask the other Blacksteel girls.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Liskarm and Franka help most of the time, but they're always on missions together, and taking R&R together.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: If one's gone, so is the other.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Franka likes to joke around, but she's actually really reliable. Puffball, Tiny, Kuro, and Stout all really love Franka!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Sometimes Jessica takes care of them, if I can't find those two. But, um, this one time, Kuro kind of startled her, and I think she was going to cry.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Didn't I bring Puffball and the gang around to meet you, Doctor?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Puffball, Tiny, and Kuro are all Originium snails. And Stout is a Sargon Desert Metal Crab, and every last one of them is cute as a button!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hm? What's wrong, Doctor?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh no... I know that look in your eyes, Doctor. No! No! No! No! You can't eat them! Not Puffball, not Tiny, not Kuro, not Stout! You can't eat any of them! I know you've been eating all kinds of weird stuff behind Dr. Kal'tsit's back!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (I was going to ask you to take care of them. But now? Hmph. No way.)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: What am I going to do? We're all going out together this time. What's going to happen to my babies?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hmmm.... The other operators are all busy with their own things, so I can't just go up and ask them out of nowhere, can I?

options: Like, try asking the next one who walks by.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh? Take this seriously!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: You're joking, right, Doctor?!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Who will it be...? Ooh, I hope it's someone reliable...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Their footsteps... are very light! With a steady pace, very steady. It must be a great warrior!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh? What's that fragrance?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I remember this scent, it's...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Melantha!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Ah?!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Y-yes, it's me.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Good afternoon, Doctor, Vanilla.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Erm, so... what can I do for you?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Sorry, it's kind of unusual for you to ask me for something. I just...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Not at all! You're a big help, Melantha! Thank you so much!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: It's nothing. And actually I'm just going to ask Steward.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: But really, I'm glad I could help.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (She's blushing!)

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Haha. Melantha is so timid off the battlefield.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll take great care of Vanilla's pets.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Thank you so much for your trouble!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Thanks, Steward.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Think nothing of it. I really won't have you standing on ceremony. We're friends.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: H- how could we be friends? You two have been with Rhodes Island for so long, you're far more senior than me!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Does company seniority matter so much...?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, by the way, is Melantha also going on this mission?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: None of my superiors mentioned it...

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Yes, I am.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: It was decided kind of suddenly. They only just told me.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: It was Master, err, Franka, who said she wanted to see how my swordsmanship was coming along. The timing was right, so she applied to have me join the team.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, Franka? She's been teaching you her sword techniques?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Is she actually a good teacher...?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I know she's really reliable, but I hope she isn't a bad influence on a good girl like Melantha.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh no, the more I think about it, the more worried I get!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Not at all! Franka likes to play around, but she's very serious when it comes to sword fighting.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: It's all thanks to Franka that I've come as far as I have. She's a great influence on me!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: ...Sorry, I may have gone a bit overboard.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: You two are actually pretty close.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But I'm glad to know that Franka is a good teacher anyway. I won't worry.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Franka is a great swordmaster. I've never seen her lose a sparring match to anyone in Blacksteel.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Master is amazing. I have a lot more to learn.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Oh, right. Sorry, but it's time for me to go.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I have an appointment with Ansel for a routine checkup today.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Routine checkup?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Yes. For Oripathy...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: What, again? Didn't you just get checked the day before yesterday?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: And Medical gave you a new drug after the last checkup, right?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Yes. It's because they want to keep tabs on my new medication.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Nothing to worry about. Dr. Warfarin says my infection is under control.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: ...I'm glad.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: You better get going for now.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Thanks again! We could get tea when you're done with your checkup, if you have time?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Oh, tea...? Erm, yeah! Sounds good!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: It's a date!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Thank you again for your help, Steward.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: And thank you, Vanilla.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Me? Huh?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Nothing. Never mind.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I feel like... Melantha changed a lot. She's in such a good mood now.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: You think so too? Melantha is much more confident now than when we first formed the squad.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Confident...? Oh, yes, it's confidence.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I've always felt that Rhodes Islanders are different from the Infected I've met in the past. I think it's because you all... live. You keep pushing so hard to live your lives, if that makes sense?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Sometimes I forget about the whole infection thing altogether.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's really incredible.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Hah. Incredible? No, I don't think so.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Rhodes Island has been forced to get involved in a lot of things, but it's still essentially a pharmaceutical company. It's always been mostly about developing medicine and the treatments for the Infected.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: An Infected person who would make the effort to come here for treatment, she's going to be the type who won't give up on life, right?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It makes sense when you put it that way.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: That's why we have to work with other organizations to make up for what we don't have.... Such is the case, for example, with Blacksteel.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Thanks to professionals like you, Vanilla, our operators are under less pressure.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: No, I'm not even a professional yet. I'm still in training. It's the senior operators who are professional mercenaries.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Liskarm and the others didn't have to take a test to come here, like I did.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: A test?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Yes. Both practical and written exams.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I spent a week in the library preparing for that written test. I didn't even sleep!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: ...Hah hah. You're a hard worker.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: That's a bit of a surprise though. Blacksteel is more serious about our cooperation agreement than I thought.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Why would you say that...? Since the Oripathy Crisis began, a lot of Blacksteel mercenaries got Infected.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: We're okay, though. And Oripathy isn't that scary to us mercenaries. Our work is dangerous enough already.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: You'll die in the end either way.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: On the other hand, some clients don't want to hire Infected. So we're getting fewer contracts, making less money, and probably causing some headaches for the bosses.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I think that's around the time we started cooperating with Rhodes Island? Franka told me about it, but I don't know the details.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: And I'm very lucky I got to come here and see so many things and meet so many people I never would've encountered before. Every single day! It's really fulfilling.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Not to mention free dessert in the cafeteria once a week! I've probably gained a lot of weight since coming here...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Probably not. As long as you keep your nutrition balanced, it's good to eat a little more. Take care not to overeat, but health is what matters.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: No, no, no, Steward, you don't understand!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's not about what other people think, it's about how it affects your mood!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: O- oh is that right?
Damn straight. Vanilla knows what she's talking about.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Ah, Blaze...! Oh.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Blaze, who is this little girl...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: This little rascal? She's Dora, one of my adorable little friends.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And please, try to chill out, Vanilla. I don't want you trying to trade business cards with a child.

steps.name: Dora..
steps.text: ...Nice to meet you.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Uh, hello.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Good afternoon, Miss Dora. Did you take your medicine today?

steps.name: Dora
steps.text: (nodding)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She pulled a half an hour of storybook time out of me on account of it tasted too bitter.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm onto you, little rascal. You said it was too bitter last time too, and Dr. Kal'tsit fixed up the taste!

steps.name: Dora
steps.text: B- but it is bad! You said so yourself!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't take the same stuff as you. No excuses.

steps.name: Dora
steps.text: Aww.

steps.name: Dora
steps.text: Um, I need to go...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, it's time for class?

steps.name: Dora
steps.text: Yes. The medic lady said she'd teach us how to make paper flowers today!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Will you make one for me? I'll give you a candy.

steps.name: Dora
steps.text: Hehehehe, I'll think about it.

steps.name: Dora
steps.text: Bye-bye, Mister, Miss!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: No running in the halls! You'll fall and hurt your——

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Oof... she fell.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: This kid....

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Haha, she's got a lot of energy.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah, she looks quiet, but she's a wrecking ball. Warfarin has to scare her into behaving... Doesn't matter. Anyway.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I've never seen you two hang out. Aren't you usually with the Blacksteel girls, Vanilla? Did Amiya organize a mixer?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh? This... we're not...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Blaze, don't joke!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Did that sound like a joke? Honestly, I think we should have a mixer where we all get together and relax.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I'm sure we'll make time. And anyway, haven't we had a few private functions? I know I've seen Blaze drinking and puking with quite a few contract operators.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Those don't count!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: That must be the 'boozy nightmare' Liskarm talks about sometimes...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: By the way, was that little girl a Rhodes Islander?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Dora? She's here for treatment, so I think she counts?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yes. But we're classified differently. Combat personnel are different from logistics personnel, and there's a few others. It's all HR stuff... you know?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: You sound unsure...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's not my wheelhouse.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why are you so fixated on Dora?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I don't know. I guess I'm just curious. I saw her when I first got here too...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I came to give the Doctor my paperwork and there was this cute Infected girl and her parents waiting outside the door. .

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: The girl, though still small, was very well-behaved. She just held onto her tattered doll. She didn't make a sound

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It was no big deal. But it made an impression.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That must have been Dora. That doll was a mess. I told her I'd buy her a new one, but she wouldn't have it. I ended up getting Bibeak to stitch it up for her.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: So it was her....

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I think I remember she's... Victorian, right?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I think so. Her medical records say she was involved in a street fight and inhaled a bunch of Originium dust.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I took a look at it before, when I was helping Hibiscus give her some shots.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: The children in that ward come from different backgrounds, but they are all in the same place now.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Cardigan likes to play with them, and Ansel always stays late after medicating them to tell stories and such. They're all very happy kids.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Dora is especially optimistic. She always says she wants to join my squad when she grows up. Where do you think she gets it from?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: To want to join Blaze's team, she must be a little unhinged.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: It's a fairly common story around here. Just pick any of the medical compartments at random and you'll find a few people who've been through similar things.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah, it's nothing new. The world sucks.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Is she... very sick?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Her family didn't look rich.... I didn't think they'd be able to afford treatment. Honestly, I kind of didn't expect to see her again.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: A normal place, where the bosses have their heads screwed on right, definitely wouldn't take a dying patient with no money.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: There's a better way to phrase it.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: But Blaze is right. There is no cure for Oripathy. And even an organization like ours has limited resources.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: ...That's why the Infected are in such a tough position.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But Rhodes Island didn't turn them away!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Rhodes Island isn't small. But I guess you can't say it's a really big organization either.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Since coming to Rhodes Island, I've seen a lot of people. A lot of Infected people who came here for medical attention.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: And some of them even came forward and said they were willing to fight.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: All of us in Reserve Op Team A4 did exactly that.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: You too, Steward?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I hadn't even heard of this place before the Blacksteel partnership. Who could imagine a company..... a company that saves the Infected and doesn't even get paid anything for it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's not quite right.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It- it's not?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's not that we don't get paid anything. We just get paid without money.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If one side has to pay too much, that's actually a big burden on both sides. An arrangement like that wouldn't last. No matter how sweet Amiya might be, she wouldn't do something like that.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: We do provide treatment. But it's definitely not free.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Here, we've got a fine example standing right here!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Oof, Blaze, you're going to break my shoulder if you keep patting me like that.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You can choose all kinds of different ways to contribute to Rhodes Island in exchange for the treatment we provide. Definitely not just fighting. Us combat operators are actually the rarest bunch.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: We got logistics to handle the paperwork, engineerings to keep Rhodes Island itself trucking along, envoys to go talk to other organizations, not to mention procurement and cleaning staff...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Even if you want to wash dishes in the cafeteria, that's fine. As long as it helps, you can do it.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Hearing it again, it does sound pretty idealistic.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Is that bad?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Not at all.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (whistling)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But, but! What can a little kid like Dora do to help Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You saw, they're about to learn how to make origami flowers.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The paper flowers they fold will be used to decorate the mixer. Then they'll be given to every operator as they come back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Since when is there a mixer?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Just now. I decided.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whatever. The point is there's work to be done. And the work those little guys do looks a little different from the work I do, but it's all important to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Now let's be real. I know you guys have been calling our company a sweatshop.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: That was a joke. Just a joke!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah, sure. That's what I say when I tease the Doctor.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Blaze, please!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Hmmm.... My opinion is a bit different from that of Blaze.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: There are some of us who trade our labor to Rhodes Island in exchange for treatment, and many more who coincidentally have interests aligned with the company.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Of course, there are many who truly believe in Amiya and her philosophy and are willing to give everything to that end.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (whistles)

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: But we don't necessarily all share those ideals. Sometimes, we just happen to be on the same path in the same direction, and end up side by side in this moment.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I think I understand, but...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: It's all right. You don't have to think about it too much.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: The important thing is that we're all getting a little bit better. Things are good for now. People are happy.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: As are you, Vanilla. You've been smiling a lot lately.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: O- oh, I have?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's probably just because I'm so fulfilled here at Rhodes Island. Although there's still a lot of things I'm not used to....

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Like doors that suddenly open on their own. And the last time I was in the corridor, some medical device suddenly started talking to me... I jumped out of my skin!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Hahaha. I suppose you aren't used to such things.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Adnachiel was telling me about the rubber band launcher he helped Exusiai make. He said you snapped it in half.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: He made that?!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: S- sorry, the rubber band startled me so, I acted on instinct...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I'm really sorry!!!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: That's okay, Adnachiel wasn't angry. He's a man of few words, but he's a gentle soul.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I can testify to that.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: But, um, if he ever comes to you with any more inventions that cause you trouble, do let me know. Or Melantha.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, I just had a thought. Maybe that whole sweatshop thing actually fits?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: ...What's this again?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I mean those kids, what are they? Child labor? An early investment?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: An early... investment?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah, it'll pay off, won't it? Rhodes Island teaches these kids all kinds of things. The little punks are probably better than us at a bunch of stuff. Like, I get a headache looking at numbers. And then when they toss letters in with the numbers...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: They're all probably going to be awesome. Way more awesome than me. They'll do all kinds of stuff I never could.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So, you know, it's a return on investment.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: A return? Not necessarily——

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Shh, let me dream. Don't say it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, it's Amiya.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Looks like another mission. I kinda wanna blow it off. I can just blow it off, right?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well, I gotta go. Vanilla, Steward, let's get a drink at that mixer!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: She talks like that, but she still walks away with a smile on her face....

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Are we really going to have a mixer? Wh- what if I don't drink?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Oh, don't mind Blaze. She's always like that. She won't force you.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: No? That's kind of a disappointment...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Okay, this is my place.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Come on in.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: All right.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Ah... so this is where Vanilla lives.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Don't laugh. It's kind of a mess.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, here's Puffball and the gang.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Puffball? What a cute n...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: ...name.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Vanilla, your pets, they're... are these... these are your pets?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: They're all cute little critters from my hometown!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Hmmm....

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: (I fear the word 'cute' has lost all meaning...)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, don't worry, Steward. Kuro may be big, but he's really the gentlest of them all!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: *Sigh*.... It's so hard to fight them on the battlefield. And Instructor Dobermann always yells at me, but I really can't help it!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I- I can tell you really like animals, Vanilla.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: And... Well, these pets, they... they certainly have character.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hehe. They sure do!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: They're very well behaved. They don't make a mess. Just give them a little food and water every day and they're good to go!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, but be careful not to press the spikes on their shells. Otherwise.....

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Otherwise?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: They explode.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Explode...?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Vanilla, is it really okay to have a pet like this in your room....?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh? Of course! I got permission from Amiya and Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: This terrarium is made of a special material that insulates the Originium. It's very safe!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Also, I prepared their food already.... See, just press the button on the side, like so, and it automatically feeds them.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hehe. Pretty crazy, huh?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I actually think it's crazier that you're here keeping Originium slugs...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Sorry, what?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, and for water, they really only need a little bit every other day. Keep the environment nice and dry, just like my hometown.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Understood, I'll make sure not to overwater them.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: These Originium snails, and that metal crab, they look nicer than any I've seen before.... Your hometown is in Sargon, correct?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: That's right. It's a very remote place in the Sargon countryside.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: What's it like?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's a.... Well, a very poor place with very few resources.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: You can't farm there, because there's nothing but sand. You have to hunt to survive. All the children in my tribe are raised to be great hunters.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: You too?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Yes, me too.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Then why did you join Blacksteel...?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's kind of embarrassing, but... for money.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Money?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Yup. Blacksteel, Blacksteel Worldwide, is just a mercenary group.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Maybe everyone joins with a different goal, but a lot of mercenaries just need money.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: And that's me.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Is that right? But it seems as though Jessica doesn't want for money?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Jessica...? She has some other motivation, I guess. She doesn't talk about these things much, so I don't really know.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But where I come from, everyone is very poor...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It doesn't rain much in the Sargon deserts. When it does, the water accumulates in small oasis pools, and caravans cross the entire desert looking for them, stopping briefly as they pass by our tribe to take out some goods to trade.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's mostly barter. No one has much money. But every home has a little something to trade.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: The caravans usually stays for just a day or two. And when it gets very cold at night, so everyone gathers around the fire.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: We eat a little jerky. The adults drink a couple of sips of wine to ward off the cold, and the kids get a handful of dates to snack on.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: The traders tell the children about what's going on in the world outside the desert, usually something new and fun.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Like how in the far, far east, there are fragrant cities with flowers everywhere, huge metropolises overflowing with wealth and happiness...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I could go for some of that.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Right? But since I've been out here, I haven't had a chance to check and see if the east is really so great.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Anyway, having heard stories like that, it's only natural I'd be curious about the outside world. There's no way I could stay in the desert and be a regular old hunter.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: So I followed the merchants out to a small town on the edge of the desert.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: And you found out things weren't as good as you thought?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: They're not so good, but also not so bad... At least the food is better than back home.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I didn't have much money on me. Everything my family had still wasn't enough. Even a hostel was too expensive to stay in.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's not like I had a lot of options besides mercenary work. But I don't regret it.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: ...Anyway, that's enough of that.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Where's your hometown, Steward?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I'm from Kjerag.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Wow! I heard it snows there all year round. Is that true? I've never seen snow...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Haha. And you never will, at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Really! Well, I'll have to save up. Jessica says those new body insulation suits are really expensive!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: ...Haha, that might be a bit overkill...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Melantha was so happy you asked her to help.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Though she may not show it, which is both a strength and a weakness of hers.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Really...? I hope I'm not being a bother.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Certainly not. It's no bother to Melantha, or myself, for that matter.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Now, off on your mission, Vanilla. And rest assured I will take excellent care of Puffball and the others.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, just a minute, Steward!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Hm? Was there something else?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Not that I totally understand everything you and Blaze were talking about, but...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Next time Reserve Op Team A4 visits the kids in the treatment wards, please bring me along!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Let's learn how to make paper flowers, so we're ready for that mixer.
